welcome.title: Welcome to Ferry
welcome.desc: Ferry runs locally, scanning your AI coding tool sessions and unifying them in one view. No login required, no data uploaded.

guide.railTitle: Switch modules via the navigation rail
guide.railBody: The rail on the far left switches between Overview, Sessions, Migrations, and Ask Ferry; drag the icons to reorder them. Rescan and Settings sit at the bottom, and the layout stays put in every module.
guide.overviewBody: Session count, token usage, estimated cost, and active-day streaks at a glance, switchable by tool and time range. Below: how your go-to model shifts over time, a 52-week activity heatmap, and auto-generated insight cards flagging notable changes.
guide.searchBody: Jump to any session by title, project directory, or command — full-text search over session content works too. Search and filter controls keep the same spot in the resource pane across modules.
guide.filterBody: Narrow the list by source agent, time range, project directory, or tags. Inline actions let you pin, rename, and tag; pinned or archived sessions are protected from deletion. This metadata stays local and never touches the original session files.
guide.detailBody: The detail view renders the full session tree, including subagent conversations and image previews. From here you can refresh, resume the conversation in your terminal, or copy the resume command; edits show a diff first, back up before applying, and can always be rolled back.
guide.scopeBody: Long sessions can be truncated at a turn with "Migrate up to here", carrying over only what came before; preview the migration impact before delivering. If verification fails, it rolls back automatically and leaves nothing behind.
guide.migrateBody: Move a session to another agent. Before writing, Ferry shows the impact: what's kept natively, what degrades, and what's lost. Confirm and it writes in the target agent's native format, then hands you a resume command to paste into your terminal. The source session stays read-only throughout.
guide.historyBody: Every migration is recorded: source, target, cost, and outcome at a glance. Look back anytime to see where a session came from and which migrations it went through.
guide.askferryBody: Let the built-in agent answer questions across sessions and run housekeeping tasks. When it's working in the background or needs your input, its rail icon lights up a badge; while browsing a session you can also summon it from the floating panel.
